description: Open a visible browser on the user's screen so THEY can sign in to the site with one demo account. Only the resulting session (cookies) is saved, under an account name in .usercase/sessions/ — the password never passes through you or us. Call it once per demo account, one at a time. Returns immediately; tell the user to sign in and close the window, then run check_site — it checks whether the sign-in really worked. If an account is not signed in or has expired, call login again with that same account name. Members (member=true) are spread across the signed-in accounts. Never ask the user for their password.

account.description: Account name to save it as (a1, a2 …). Leave out for a new account; give an existing name to sign in again

lifetimeHours.description: How long a sign-in lasts, if the auth code says (e.g. a session maxAge or ttl). Shown as time left, and the account is not used after it

url.description: The sign-in page, or any page of the site

window.description: Which window. chrome (default): the user's normal Chrome — Google and other sign-in buttons work, but a sign-in cookie that lasts only until the browser closes is lost. playwright: keeps such cookies, but Google sign-in is blocked there. Choose from the site's auth code; leave out if unsure

name: login
